archive.hint: A public page where worshippers can read past khutbahs with their approved translations, at any time.

handout.title: Handout

insight.title: Attendance insight
insight.hint: For each khutbah: the most screens and phones connected at once, and the distinct phones that followed. Nothing personal is stored.
insight.empty: No completed sessions yet. Numbers appear after the first live khutbah.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.hint: Pro mosques can use their own address (khutbah.alnoor.org.sa) for screens, phones and the admin instead of the Jumaah address.
domain.notCloud: Custom domains are available on Jumaah Cloud.
domain.verifiedToast: Domain verified. HTTPS is set up automatically on the first visit.
domain.dnsTitle: DNS record to create at your domain provider
domain.instructions: Create a CNAME record for {{domain}} pointing to {{target}}, then press "Verify DNS". DNS changes can take up to an hour to spread.
domain.tlsHint: Once verified, the HTTPS certificate is issued automatically on the first visit, and all links switch to the new address.

errors.NO_RECORD: No DNS record found for this name yet.
errors.WRONG_TARGET: The record points to {{value}} instead of {{target}}.
errors.DNS_ERROR: DNS lookup failed ({{value}}). Try again in a few minutes.
errors.PLATFORM_DOMAIN: Choose a domain you own, not a Jumaah address.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.pluralHint: One account managing several mosques. Member mosques move to the Organisation plan and share its AI allowance.
organisation.notMember: You are not an organisation admin.
organisation.name: Name
organisation.adminHint: Only admins of member mosques can be added. They sign in again to see the organisation.

network.title: Shared translation network
network.hint: Mosques on Jumaah Cloud share approved translations of identical Arabic paragraphs (verses, du‘a, common phrases). When a match exists it is used before any AI, saving allowance and time. Shared translations arrive as "reviewed" and still need your approval.
network.read: Use translations shared by other mosques
network.publish: Share our approved translations with other mosques
network.publishHint: Only approved text is shared, without the khutbah, the imam or the mosque name. Switching off removes everything you shared.

api.title: API & webhooks
api.hint: Connect your own systems: read and create khutbahs, drive the live session, and get notified of events.
api.locked: API access is part of the Pro and Organisation plans.
api.keyOnce: Copy the key now. For your safety it is stored hashed and will not be shown again.
api.webhooksHint: We POST a signed JSON message to your HTTPS address when the chosen events happen. Verify the X-Jumaah-Signature header with the secret shown once at creation.
api.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now; it will not be shown again.
api.docsAuth: Send the key as a bearer token on the same address as this admin. Read-only keys accept GET requests only.
api.docsEndpoints: Common endpoints (every endpoint the admin uses is available):

cycles.YEARLY: Yearly · SAR {{price}} a year (two months free)

billing.vatHint: VAT of {{rate}}% is added to invoices.
billing.noVatHint: No VAT is charged yet; it is added once the company is VAT-registered.
billing.viaOrganisation: This mosque is billed through its organisation ({{name}}).
billing.bankHint: Quote the invoice number in the transfer; the invoice is marked paid within one working day.
billing.noPaymentMethod: No payment method is configured yet. Please contact us.
billing.notCloud: Billing only applies to Jumaah Cloud.
billing.runDone: Issued {{issued}} invoice(s), {{overdue}} past due, {{cancelled}} cancelled, {{trialsEnded}} trial(s) ended, {{trialNotices}} trial notice(s) sent.
billing.subscribeHint: An invoice for the coming period is issued at once; the new plan applies as soon as it is paid. During the trial the period starts today.
billing.cancelHint: Stops renewals; the mosque keeps everything and falls back to the free plan when the paid period ends.
billing.customInvoiceHint: For bulk contracts and adjustments: your own wording, quantity and unit price in SAR. VAT is added as configured.

platformConfig.title: Platform settings
platformConfig.hint: Billing, payments, email and security are edited here and take effect within a minute. Values from the environment (.env) are the defaults; anything saved here overrides them. Secrets are stored encrypted and shown only as a hint.
platformConfig.payTestHint: Moyasar test keys (sk_test_…) work against the same API with test cards, so the whole flow can be tried before going live. Live keys start with sk_live_.

tenants.paidUntilHint: Platform AI keeps working for 7 days after this date, then switches off. Manual translation, review and screens never stop. New mosques start with a 30-day trial.
tenants.aiUsageHint: Platform-provider translations per mosque. A mosque's own keys are not counted.
tenants.latestImageTagHint: Software version offered to mosque servers

subscription.trial: Free trial · {{days}} day(s) left, ends {{date}}. Subscribe at any time; nothing is lost at the end.
subscription.pastDue: Payment overdue for invoice {{number}}. Please pay within the grace period to keep your plan.
subscription.cancelling: Renewal is stopped: the plan ends on {{date}} and the mosque falls back to the free plan.
subscription.free: This mosque is on the free plan. Subscribe to unlock automatic translation, branding and more.
